name: What safety features should I include with a low threshold shower installation?

mainEntity.name: What safety features should I include with a low threshold shower installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritize slip-resistant flooring, secure support, and proper drainage. Textured, matte-finish porcelain or small-format mosaic tiles provide more grout lines and better traction underfoot when wet. Before hanging drywall or tile backer, have your contractor install solid wood blocking in the wall framing to anchor grab bars securely. Additionally, consider handheld showerheads on an adjustable slide bar, pressure-balanced valves to prevent scalding, and a built-in shower bench for added stability during bathing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key safety features include slip-resistant mosaic or textured tile, internal wall blocking for grab bars, a built-in bench, and an adjustable handheld showerhead.
